criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Generate cautious, evidence-grounded explanations that distinguish dataset associations from diagnosis or treatment advice.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Retrieve from approved healthcare sources with traceable citations and abstain when evidence is unavailable.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Use schema-constrained read-only queries, reject unsafe SQL and minimize exposure of sensitive patient data.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Coordinate retrieval, data query and summarization tools with clear boundaries, routing and error handling.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Test grounding, privacy, fairness, uncertainty and unsafe clinical claims; require qualified clinical review for clinical decisions.
